module_summary: 64-bit arithmetic shift register: one register either loads parallel data or shifts left/right by 1 or 8 bits selected by amount.

anchors.name: q
anchors.why: 64-bit shift register contents, loaded from data or shifted per amount; drives output.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Parallel 64-bit load value written into q when load asserted.

anchors.name: load
anchors.why: Synchronous parallel load enable, overrides shifting of q.

anchors.name: ena
anchors.why: Shift enable; when high q shifts according to amount.

anchors.name: amount
anchors.why: Selects shift direction and distance: left/right by 1 or 8 bits.

groups.name: shift_register
groups.description: 64-bit register with load path and four arithmetic/logical shift options.

groups.name: shift_control
groups.description: Load, shift enable and amount select controlling q update.
